scope: 确立未保存草稿暂存机制与边界。sessionStorage 数据按标签页隔离并在页面刷新与恢复时保持，但标签页彻底关闭后数据被清空，不能承诺跨标签页关闭必恢复；支持按 noteId 和 libraryGeneration 隔离草稿并提供手动导出草稿能力。
content: The read-only sessionStorage property accesses a session Storage object for the current origin. sessionStorage is similar to localStorage; the difference is that while localStorage is partitioned by origin only, sessionStorage is partitioned by both origin and browser tabs (top-level browsing contexts). The data in sessionStorage is only kept for the duration of the page session... A page session lasts as long as the tab or the browser is open, and survives over page reloads and restores... Closing the tab/window ends the session and clears objects in sessionStorage.
